Actions.Name: Smart App
Actions.Tooltip: Focus an existing app or launch it when it is not running, with active-app feedback.

Actions.Name: Smart Context
Actions.Tooltip: Show a useful command that adapts to the foreground app while keeping the rest of your deck predictable.

Actions.Name: Workspace
Actions.Tooltip: Open a workspace preset or custom set of apps and arrange only those windows.

Actions.Name: Window Control
Actions.Tooltip: Snap, center, restore, toggle always-on-top, minimize, maximize, or move the active window.

Actions.Name: Clipboard
Actions.Tooltip: Paste recent local clipboard text or clear PackRat clipboard history.

Actions.Name: Text Snippet
Actions.Tooltip: Paste reusable text with optional local date, time, and clipboard tokens.

Actions.Name: Capture
Actions.Tooltip: Capture a region, full screen, active window, or open the screenshots folder.

Actions.Name: Media Control
Actions.Tooltip: Mute, adjust volume, play or pause, and change tracks.

Actions.Name: System Control
Actions.Tooltip: Open common Windows surfaces, show desktop, or lock the PC.

Actions.Name: Ultimate Navigation
Actions.Tooltip: Switch between profiles bundled with Ultimate.

Actions.Name: Smart Audio
Actions.Tooltip: Switch audio devices, control microphone state, restore previous audio, or use Stream Deck+ audio dials.

Actions.Name: Audio Preset
Actions.Tooltip: Apply your Work, Focus, Meeting, or Gaming audio setup with explicit mic safety.

Actions.Name: Routine
Actions.Tooltip: Run a one-press Work, Focus, Meeting, or Gaming routine with workspace and audio together.

Actions.Name: Ultimate Setup
Actions.Tooltip: Open the local Ultimate onboarding wizard for detected apps, audio, presets, and workspaces.

Actions.Name: Diagnostics Report
Actions.Tooltip: Create a privacy-safe local support report without clipboard contents, snippet text, workspace URLs, raw logs, or full custom paths.

Author: Packrat
Description: A ready-to-use Windows control system for apps, adaptive context controls, workspaces, windows, clipboard, audio devices, microphone, routines, capture, media and everyday system controls, with privacy-safe diagnostics for support.
